Welcome to the interactive explorer for the **C-Turkey Dataset**. This portal allows researchers to filter, search, and export curated radiocarbon records based on material, species, and genomic integration status.

For details on methodology and primary sources, please refer to the [main repository](https://github.com/ezgimo/C-Turkey) and the associated publication.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Veriyi oku
df <- read_tsv("data/processed/cturkey_v0.tsv")


# Tabloyu oluştur
datatable(
  df,
  filter = 'top',
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf'),
    pageLength = 15,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))
  ),
  class = 'cell-border stripe',
  rownames = FALSE
)
```
